The mini player at the bottom is always visible: play and pause, stop, previous and next, shuffle, repeat, favorite and add-to-playlist buttons. The Play button above a list (Tracks, Albums, Artists, Folders tabs or inside a folder or playlist) plays exactly the list that is open on the screen. Without a selection it shows the number of tracks on the tab; if you select tracks, files, albums, artists, folders or playlists, it plays only the selection and shows how many tracks are selected. Shuffle and repeat always follow the buttons of the mini player: with shuffle on, playback starts from a random track, otherwise from the first one. Play in the mini player pauses and resumes whatever is already playing. Tap a track to play the whole list from it. Tap the arrows icon or the title to open the full screen player, and collapse it to keep browsing. Settings → Open player on Play can open the full screen player automatically. Drag along the progress bar to seek. Stop clears the queue. Active buttons are filled with color, inactive ones are muted, unavailable ones are pale.

Tabs: Tracks, Albums, Artists, Folders, Playlists and Files. Under the tabs choose All, Music or Books: books are audiobooks, podcasts and any track longer than the length set in Settings. The magnifier searches and the sort button orders the list (title, file name, artist, recently added, duration). Inside a folder or playlist the top bar has its own search, sort menu, equalizer and settings. The microphone adds spoken text. Numbers in names are sorted naturally: 1, 2, 3 … 10, 11, 12.

Long-press a track, album, artist or folder to start selecting, then tap the others. Selected items get a colored highlight and a check mark; unselected ones show an empty circle. The bar at the top lets you play, play next, add to the queue, add to a playlist or to favorites, or play the selection on repeat. Folders can be selected and played without opening them.
Files tab and your own folders

On the Files tab add folders (for example on an SD card) or pick single files. Tap a folder to browse it, press the play icon to play everything inside. Long-press folders to select several and play them or add them to playlists and favorites.

The heart in a track row adds the track to Favorites. The playlist icon opens your playlists and turns into a check mark when the track is already in one. In that window playlists that already contain the track are highlighted (for several tracks it shows how many of them are there), the window tells you if the track is in Favorites, never creates duplicates, and the minus button takes the track out of a playlist. Open Favorites or any playlist and use the menu to clear it. Shuffle and repeat are in the mini player and the full screen player. To play several folders, albums, artists or playlists at once, long-press one, tap the others and press Play above the list. The select-all icon in the top bar selects everything, and a second tap clears the selection.

Open it with the sliders icon; the icon is highlighted while the equalizer is on. Switch it on, choose a preset or drag the 12 bands (double-tap a band to reset it). Below are preamp, bass, treble, stereo width, balance and other effects. Tap a value to reset it.
Tap the three dots on a track and choose About track to see the file name, real format, location in the folder tree, size, duration, bitrate and tags. The text can be selected and copied.

Theme (system, light or dark), language (system, English or Russian), hiding very short tracks, keeping the screen on while the player is open, rescanning the library, rating the app and contacting the developer.

Popular formats work: MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG, Opus, AAC, M4A, MKA, AMR. Rare formats such as WMA, APE or DSD are not supported: such a file is skipped with a message. Open About track to see the real format of a file. If playback problems appear in the audio chain, the player switches to a safe mode without the equalizer automatically.
Questions and bug reports: vl.profits@gmail.com. Please include the version number from Settings → About.
